scenes.text: He nodded the whole time. But did he actually understand?
Yes, yes, that's all fine. My taxi's here in ten minutes.
One moment from a working day. Carecraft gives you sixty seconds to decide.
Hand him the leaflet? Repeat it slowly, and ask for questions? Or something better?
So I know I've explained it well, how will you describe the plan to your daughter tonight?
Strongest choice. Teach-back checks your explanation, not the patient. Any gap shows while he's still on the ward.
Every option is explained. Because nodding is not evidence of understanding.
Then go deeper, with an eight-minute lesson on conversations that build trust.
Practise the moments that matter. Try it free today, at Carecraft dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
